f4d_ceiling_round1.hint: The amount-weighted sum of the two used energies, −20290.64 and −20558.60.

f4d_d_mu_round1.hint: The rise between the two used states divided by their distance in x, 0.14887.

f4d_remaining_round3.hint: The deepest dip printed for round 3, without its minus sign.
